summary.current_focus: Qwen full-serving correctness and benchmark-model progress
summary.recent_pattern: The latest commits include more Qwen runtime fixes, but the window is still dominated by tests, benchmark-viewer data, and evidence-policy guardrails.
summary.reflection: The guardrails prevented false paper-readiness claims, but the work has spent too much time on non-feature surfaces. The next slices should fix benchmark model execution paths before adding more reporting contracts.
summary.test_strategy: Keep one broad viewer contract check plus focused generator and policy tests. Avoid sparse row-by-row tests for every imported artifact; prefer large integrated tests that exercise benchmark-model execution, viewer import, and report validation together.
